# Dudley Development

> Dudley Development is an independent iOS app studio. We build small, polished, playful apps for iPhone — mostly funny, sometimes useful. Every app is free, and every app explains its account, cloud-data, analytics, advertising, and tracking behavior in a dedicated privacy policy. Founded and run by Nicholas Santulli.

## Apps

- [Monetary Policy: Independence Day](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/monetary-policy-independence-day/): A free satirical iPhone economics game — a 100-level Independence Day campaign that turns Fed policy into micro-game chaos with a new cast. Live on the App Store. Requires iOS 16.6+.
- [Dude, Where's This House?](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6779785617): A free iPhone geography game built for HomeLight with 5,000 approved U.S. residential locations. Explore Street View, play five timed rounds, pin each house on the map, and score by distance. Optional player accounts save scores and leaderboard identity. Live on the App Store as version 1.1. Requires iOS 17+.
- [VibeRater Social](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/vibe-rater/): A free iPhone social app built around playful photo ratings, Vibes posts, Vibies, VibeChecks, Squad, Radar, Rise, optional SlopGuard, and shareable vibe cards. Choose a photo, get a VibeMeter score, aura-style read, archetype, and vibe anthem, then decide whether to keep it private, post it, or share it. Live on the App Store. Requires iOS 17+.
- [Table Talk: Conversation Cards](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/table-talk/): A free iPhone app of beautifully designed conversation-starter cards for date nights, family dinners, friend groups, work teams, deep questions, and light fun. 185 prompts, no account, works offline, free with optional one-time ad-free upgrade. Live on the App Store. Requires iOS 16.6+.
- Last Human: A free satirical top-down arcade game for iPhone — you're the last human in an AI-automated office, dodging AutoBots to reach the time clock before the timer runs out. Free with optional ad-free upgrade (in-app purchase). iOS. Launching on the App Store soon.
- EconByte: A free iPhone app that explains economics in bite-sized daily cards — inflation, interest rates, GDP, trade — like a smart friend, not a textbook. Educational only, not investment advice. Free with optional ad-free upgrade (in-app purchase). iOS. Launching on the App Store soon.

## Archetypes (Vibe Rater)

Vibe Rater assigns one of several vibe archetypes based on your photo:

- [Main Character Energy](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/main-character/): The protagonist of every room. Confident, intentional presence.
- [Final Boss](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/final-boss/): Peak power. Effortless authority; maxed Main-Character, Rizz, and Serve.
- [Quiet Luxury](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/quiet-luxury/): Understated, expensive elegance with no loud logos.
- [Clean Girl](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/clean-girl/): Minimal, polished, effortless — glowy skin and gold hoops.
- [Dark Academia](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/dark-academia/): Old libraries, tweed, candlelight, intellectual mood.
- [Cottagecore](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/cottagecore/): Soft, rural, slow living. High Aura, peaceful energy.
- [Cozy Goblin](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/cozy-goblin/): Maximally comfortable, endearingly chaotic. Zero Serve, infinite Aura.
- [Rizz](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/rizz/): Natural charisma and social magnetism.

## Tools

- [What's My Vibe? Quiz](https://dudleyapps.com/tools/whats-my-vibe/): A free 5-question quiz that reveals your vibe archetype. Powered by Vibe Rater logic.

## Blog

The Dudley Blog covers internet culture, vibe archetypes, and honest app roundups. Full index: https://dudleyapps.com/blog/ (RSS: https://dudleyapps.com/blog/rss.xml).

- [What Does Limited Access Mean for Photos on iPhone?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-does-limited-access-mean-photos-iphone/): Limited Access means an iPhone app can use only the photos and videos you select, not your whole photo library. Here is what it changes, how to check it, and what to watch before using photo apps.
- [Does ChatGPT Use Your Photos To Train AI?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/does-chatgpt-use-your-photos-to-train-ai/): ChatGPT can use content you upload, including images, to improve OpenAI's models unless your plan or data controls say otherwise. Here is the practical photo privacy checklist.
- [Does iPhone Share Photo Metadata When You Send a Picture?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/does-iphone-share-photo-metadata/): Yes, iPhone photo sharing can include metadata such as date, time, location, device details, and captions. Here is how to remove location before sharing and what to check before using photo apps.
- [Can iPhone Apps See Your Screenshots?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/can-iphone-apps-see-your-screenshots/): iPhone apps cannot automatically browse every screenshot, but an active app can know when you take a screenshot and photo permissions decide what screenshots you can share later.
- [Can People See Reels You Liked on Instagram?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/can-people-see-reels-you-liked-on-instagram/): Instagram likes are not always private. The Friends tab in Reels can surface public Reels your friends liked, commented on, reposted, or created, so check your activity controls before you treat a like as invisible.
- [Why Did My Photo Get a Made With AI Label?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/why-did-my-photo-get-made-with-ai-label/): A Made with AI label usually means a platform, tool, disclosure setting, or content credential signaled that media was meaningfully AI-generated or altered. Here is what the label can and cannot prove.
- [Can AI Photo Apps Use Your Photos To Train AI?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/can-ai-photo-apps-use-your-photos-to-train-ai/): Some AI services can use saved media to improve models, but every photo app is different. Here is how to check AI training, iPhone photo access, privacy labels, and VibeRater's entertainment boundary.
- [Does Apple Intelligence Label AI-Edited Photos?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/does-apple-intelligence-label-ai-edited-photos/): Apple says AI-edited Photos and Image Playground creations will include hidden SynthID watermarks. Here is what that means before you post AI edits, vibe cards, or group-chat photos.
- [Does Instagram Map Show Your Location From Photos?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/does-instagram-map-show-your-location-from-photos/): Instagram Map can show location-tagged content, but that is different from sharing your live or last-active location. Here is what iPhone photo posters should check before sharing.
- [Can Your iPhone Prove a Photo Is Real?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/can-iphone-prove-photo-is-real/): New iPhone provenance ideas could make some photos easier to authenticate, but they are not magic AI detectors. Here is what photo proof means for AI images, social posts, and vibe-check apps.
- [Can Apps See Hidden Photos on iPhone?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/can-apps-see-hidden-photos-iphone/): Hidden photos are locked in the Photos app, and iPhone photo permissions still matter. Here is what apps can see, what Photo Picker protects, and how to share one image safely.
- [What Is Captured by Me on iPhone?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-is-captured-by-me-iphone/): Captured by Me is a reported iOS 27 Photos collection for pictures taken with your iPhone camera. Here is what it means for finding cleaner photos to edit, share, or use in photo apps.
- [Can Smart Glasses Record You?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/can-smart-glasses-record-you/): Smart glasses can record photos or video from the wearer's point of view, so consent, posting choices, and app privacy settings matter. Here is the practical privacy check before filming or sharing group moments.
- [What Is a Vibe Check?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-is-a-vibe-check/): A vibe check is a quick read on the mood, energy, or social fit of a person, place, photo, or moment. Here is what it means, how to use it, and where playful vibe apps fit.
- [What Does Aura Mean in Slang?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-does-aura-mean-in-slang/): Aura slang means cool presence, social energy, or the imaginary points people gain and lose online. Here is how aura points work and how to use the term without taking it too seriously.
- [Do AI Photo Apps Need AI Act Labels?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/do-ai-photo-apps-need-ai-act-labels/): The EU AI Act transparency rules start applying on August 2, 2026. Here is what AI photo app users should know about labels, deepfakes, and honest vibe-check posts.
- [What Is AI Slop?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-is-ai-slop/): AI slop is low-effort AI-generated content that makes feeds feel fake, repetitive, or misleading. Here is what it means for photo trends, social apps, and vibe-check posts.
- [Can AI Use Your Instagram Photos?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/can-ai-use-your-instagram-photos/): Meta pulled back a July 2026 feature that let people reference public Instagram accounts in AI images, but public social photos still deserve careful privacy settings and context.
- [Should You Give an AI Photo App Full Photo Access?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/should-you-give-ai-photo-app-full-photo-access/): Most AI photo apps do not need your whole camera roll for a single edit, aura card, or vibe check. Here is when full photo access makes sense and when to use a picker instead.
- [Can Photo Apps See Your Location?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/can-photo-apps-see-your-location/): Photo apps may receive location metadata when you share or upload an image. Here is how iPhone photo location data works and what to check before using an aura or AI photo app.
- [Do AI Photo Apps Need Labels on TikTok?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/do-ai-photo-apps-need-labels-on-tiktok/): TikTok asks creators to label realistic AI-generated or significantly AI-edited content. Here is what that means before you share AI photo, aura, or vibe-check results.

## About

Dudley Development is the public-facing studio name of Dudley Development, LLC. The studio is run by a small team and one human (Nicholas Santulli). All apps are free. Account needs, cloud storage, analytics, advertising, and tracking behavior vary by app and are disclosed in each app's privacy policy. VibeRater Social is for entertainment, does not sell personal information, and does not request cross-app tracking permission.
